summary: CoinMarketCap’s Altcoin Season Index came in at 52, down four points from yesterday.The index is calculated by comparing Bitcoin’s price performance with that of the top 100 coins by market capitalization, excluding stablecoins and wrapped coins. A CoinNess analysis shows altcoin season is identified when 75% of the top 100 coins post gains over the past 90 days that exceed Bitcoin’s return over the same period. The opposite is considered Bitcoin season. A reading closer to 100 indicates stronger altcoin season conditions.

title: Korea Exchange triggers Kospi circuit breaker after 8% drop
summary: The Korea Exchange triggered a circuit breaker after the Kospi fell more than 8%. A circuit breaker is a mechanism that temporarily halts trading when the Kospi or Kosdaq drops sharply, with three stages in total. Under a first-stage circuit breaker, which is triggered when a decline of at least 8% lasts for one minute, trading is suspended for about 20 minutes.

title: U.S. Senate may delay Clarity Act vote until after next week
summary: The U.S. Senate's focus on a Russia sanctions bill and federal nominations has increased the likelihood that a vote on the Clarity Act, a crypto market structure bill, will be pushed back until after next week, CoinDesk reported. The outlet said the Senate's practice of handling only one contentious bill at a time has made it difficult to take up the Clarity Act before other items are cleared. Disagreements also remain over a provision that would restrict cryptocurrency business activities by senior officials, including President Donald Trump. As a result, it remains unclear whether the Senate can act on the bill before its summer recess on Aug. 8, and the wider the disagreements become, the lower the chances of passage in 2026. CoinDesk added that even if the bill clears the Senate, it would still need another House vote and the president's signature.
